## Verdict: GREEN

No unresolved findings. The six corrections and the promotion-usage neighbor hold in the current tree. Completion, expiry, reconciliation, delivery rating, provider-id enrichment, and booking recovery each do what the fix required, and the adjacent paths that share those locks and journals do not replay money, starve later orders, or hide a purchased shipment.

Model: Grok 4.7 (selector `grok-4.7`, engine `grok-4.7-build`), effort xhigh. Session `01a12543-056a-74d3-968c-3193d39f0536`. This is the synthesis of that same read-only pass. Owner-reported validation (2075 tests / 14472 assertions, root Pint, PHPStan, normal Composer Rector, all exit 0) was not re-run here and is not the basis of the verdict.

## Disposition

**A1, Major, P7.4 — closed.** `OrderStatus::derive` completes a placed order only when nothing is outstanding, at least one unit is fulfilled, and gross `captured >= amountDue` (`OrderStatus.php:165`). A refund still sets `PartiallyRefunded` or `Refunded` and does not prove payment. `PaymentJournal::open` refuses only a non-placed order (`PaymentJournal.php:75-76`), and the balance is amount due minus gross captured, so a fulfilled partial capture stays payable. A later capture that reaches `amountDue` completes once and emits `sales.order_completed`.

**Promotion neighbor, P7.8 — closed.** `RefundJournal::refundsOrderFully` restores usage only when gross captured covers `amountDue` and this success returns the rest of that captured sum (`RefundJournal.php:412-413`). It runs only on a real transition to `succeeded`, after `stillHeld`. A full refund of a partial capture does not restore. Refunding the remainder after the order was fully captured does, once. An ignored repeat does not call it.

**A2, Major, P7.4 — closed.** `OrderExpiry::candidates` drops orders with a payment in `PAYMENTS_UNDER_WAY` or any `fulfilled_quantity > 0` before `LIMIT` (`OrderExpiry.php:93-100`). The same statuses and the line sum are checked again under `for update skip locked` (`OrderLocks.php:44`, `OrderExpiry.php:114-121`). A failed lock or a lost race advances `(payment_due_at, id)` and refills. The limit counts successful expirations only. `skipped` counts those locked or raced candidates. A known ineligible prefix does not occupy the limit.

**A3, Major, P7.5 — closed.** `PaymentTransitions` allows `pending → requires_action` at rank 1 and a new action URL while still at rank ≤ 1 (`PaymentTransitions.php:32-38`). The same URL is ignored. `authorized` and `captured` do not move back. `PaymentWorkflow::answered` passes the gateway URL (`PaymentWorkflow.php:188`), and `validate` rejects `requires_action` without an http(s) URL (`PaymentWorkflow.php:248`).

**A4, Major, P7.2 — closed.** `deliveryOptions` sums every settled line’s subtotal and its adjustments, which are the line discounts plus the allocated order shares (`DatabaseCarts.php:225-232`). That equals `DeliveryStage::goods`: `itemsNet()` plus order-target adjustments (`DeliveryStage.php:92-102`). Cart promotions run before the delivery anchor, so the no-delivery options quote and the selected-method quote see the same base. The parcel weight and sellable refs stay on lines that require shipping. `FulfillmentBooking::request` still declares only the fulfilled share of those shipping lines (`FulfillmentBooking.php:66-76`).

**A5, Major, P7.5 — closed.** An ignored payment observation with a missing provider id is written through `PaymentJournal::write` as the same status and amounts, then returned as `ignored` without `applied` (`DatabasePayments.php:78-88`). The inbox row stays `ignored`, so the same event is a duplicate. A later capture locates the stored `external_id`. The refund path does the same: `RefundJournal::write` keeps `next` null, strips a stale error, skips `settled` and promotion restore, and stores only `external_id` (`RefundJournal.php:245-278`). `DatabaseRefunds` returns `ignored` because the status did not change (`DatabaseRefunds.php:85-95`). A real status change still posts the refund once.

**G1, Minor, P7.6 — closed.** `book` commits `booking_requested` under the order lock and the fulfillment lock before `ShipmentBooking::book` (`DatabaseFulfillments.php:110-131`). Sales calls that public port from `FulfillmentBooking` only. A manual shipment with no intent returns the current view and does not call the carrier. After the intent is stored, a retry uses `fulfillment:{id}` even if a manual `ship` won. Matching carrier and tracking attaches `method_code` and `label_ref` and does not emit a second `sales.fulfillment_shipped` (`DatabaseFulfillments.php:231-237`). A different tracking leaves the manual shipment and throws `sales.fulfillment_already_shipped` with `BookedShipment` plus `booking_reference`, `booking_carrier`, `booking_tracking`, and `booking_label_ref` (`FulfillmentAlreadyShipped.php:36-46`). The column is added by `2026_10_14_100005_add_commerz_fulfillment_booking_intent.php`, loaded with the rest of the package migrations. Existing shipment columns are unchanged and the default is false.

## Findings

None.
